description: Defines the interface IGraphingOptions for graphing configuration options, including methods for getting/setting visual styles, colors, axis options, and other graph features.

classes.name: IGraphingOptions
classes.description: Interface for graphing options, including methods for configuring visual styles, colors, axis labels, and graph features.

methods.name: ResetMarkKeyGraphFeaturesData
methods.description: Resets the data related to key graph features.

methods.name: GetMarkZeros
methods.description: Returns whether zeros are marked on the graph.

methods.name: SetMarkZeros
methods.description: Sets whether zeros should be marked on the graph.

methods.name: GetMarkYIntercept
methods.description: Returns whether Y intercepts are marked.

methods.name: SetMarkYIntercept
methods.description: Sets whether Y intercepts should be marked.

methods.name: GetMarkMinima
methods.description: Returns whether minima are marked.

methods.name: SetMarkMinima
methods.description: Sets whether minima should be marked.

methods.name: GetMarkMaxima
methods.description: Returns whether maxima are marked.

methods.name: SetMarkMaxima
methods.description: Sets whether maxima should be marked.

methods.name: GetMarkInflectionPoints
methods.description: Returns whether inflection points are marked.

methods.name: SetMarkInflectionPoints
methods.description: Sets whether inflection points should be marked.

methods.name: GetMarkVerticalAsymptotes
methods.description: Returns whether vertical asymptotes are marked.

methods.name: SetMarkVerticalAsymptotes
methods.description: Sets whether vertical asymptotes should be marked.

methods.name: GetMarkHorizontalAsymptotes
methods.description: Returns whether horizontal asymptotes are marked.

methods.name: SetMarkHorizontalAsymptotes
methods.description: Sets whether horizontal asymptotes should be marked.

methods.name: GetMarkObliqueAsymptotes
methods.description: Returns whether oblique asymptotes are marked.

methods.name: SetMarkObliqueAsymptotes
methods.description: Sets whether oblique asymptotes should be marked.

methods.name: GetMaxExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum execution time for graphing.

methods.name: SetMaxExecutionTime
methods.description: Sets the maximum execution time for graphing.

methods.name: ResetMaxExecutionTime
methods.description: Resets the maximum execution time to default.

methods.name: GetGraphColors
methods.description: Returns the list of colors used for graphs.

methods.name: SetGraphColors
methods.description: Sets the colors used for graphs.

methods.name: ResetGraphColors
methods.description: Resets graph colors to default.

methods.name: GetBackColor
methods.description: Returns the background color.

methods.name: SetBackColor
methods.description: Sets the background color.

methods.name: ResetBackColor
methods.description: Resets background color to default.

methods.name: SetAllowKeyGraphFeaturesForFunctionsWithParameters
methods.description: Enables or disables key graph features for functions with parameters.

methods.name: GetAllowKeyGraphFeaturesForFunctionsWithParameters
methods.description: Returns whether key graph features are allowed for functions with parameters.

methods.name: ResetAllowKeyGraphFeaturesForFunctionsWithParameters
methods.description: Resets this setting to default.

methods.name: SetZerosColor
